summary: 近期，埃塞俄比亚与厄立特里亚紧张关系升级。埃塞关闭驻厄使馆并驱逐厄外交官，厄宣布两国断交；埃塞政府军收复提格雷州首府默克莱后继续向厄边境推进。本轮危机导火索是提格雷冲突重燃：9月“提人阵”等反对派组建反政府联盟并夺取机场，与政府军交火；埃塞
summary_en: Tensions between Ethiopia and Eritrea have escalated recently. Ethiopia closed its embassy in Eritrea and expelled Eritrean diplomats; Eritrea announced the severing of diplomatic relations. Ethiopian government forces recaptured Mekelle, capital of Tigray, and continued advancing toward the Eritrean border. The trigger was renewed Tigray conflict: in September, the TPLF and other opposition groups formed an anti-government alliance and seized an airport, clashing with government forces.

title: 贸易壁垒解不了欧洲竞争力之困（环球走笔）
title_en: Trade barriers cannot solve Europe's competitiveness woes (Global Notes)
summary: 欧盟峰会聚焦提升竞争力，但欧洲结构性难题未解。德拉吉报告指出的能源成本高、投资不足、创新偏弱、市场壁垒等问题两年间未见根本改观，20项核心改革建议落实率仅约26%。峰会虽部署工业加速器法案、简化监管、深化统一市场整合，但落地困难。能源政策上
summary_en: The EU summit focused on boosting competitiveness, but Europe's structural problems remain unresolved. Problems highlighted by the Draghi report—high energy costs, underinvestment, weak innovation and market barriers—have not fundamentally improved in two years, and only about 26% of 20 core reform recommendations have been implemented. The summit set out an Industrial Accelerator Act, regulatory simplification and deeper single market integration, but implementation remains difficult.

title: 纪念东京审判开庭八十周年图片展在纽约联合国总部开展
title_en: Photo exhibition marking 80th anniversary of opening of Tokyo Trial opens at UN Headquarters in New York
summary: 纪念东京审判开庭80周年图片展在纽约联合国总部开展。中国常驻联合国代表傅聪在开幕式上肯定东京审判巩固战后国际秩序、捍卫公平正义、推动国际法治进步，同时批评日本右翼势力质疑东京审判合法性、掩盖侵略历史，并指出日方架空“和平宪法”、解禁“集体自
summary_en: A photo exhibition marking the 80th anniversary of the opening of the Tokyo Trials opened at UN Headquarters in New York. China's Permanent Representative to the UN Fu Cong said at the opening that the Tokyo Trials consolidated the post-war international order, safeguarded fairness and justice, and promoted the international rule of law. He criticized Japanese right-wing forces for questioning the legitimacy of the Tokyo Trials and concealing the history of aggression, and noted that Japan has hollowed out its pacifist constitution and lifted the ban on collective self-defense.

title: 非洲多国加强应对埃博拉疫情
title_en: African Countries Step Up Response to Ebola Outbreak
summary: 非洲多国加强应对埃博拉疫情。非洲疾控中心召开卫生部长高级别视频会议，推动加强监测、接触者追踪、感染防控和跨境协调。截至10月25日，刚果（金）累计确诊埃博拉病例10060例，死亡4887例，病死率48.6%，疫情波及8省，近期新增病例小幅上
summary_en: African countries are stepping up their response to the Ebola outbreak. The Africa CDC held a high-level virtual meeting of health ministers to strengthen surveillance, contact tracing, infection prevention and control, and cross-border coordination. As of Oct. 25, the Democratic Republic of the Congo had recorded 10,060 confirmed Ebola cases and 4,887 deaths, a case fatality rate of 48.6%, with the outbreak affecting eight provinces and recent new cases rising slightly.

title: 卢拉连任巴西总统
title_en: Lula re-elected as Brazil's president
summary: 巴西高等选举法院当地时间10月25日晚公布总统选举第二轮投票计票结果，劳工党候选人、现任总统卢拉以51.79%的得票率战胜自由党候选人、前总统雅伊尔·博索纳罗之子弗拉维奥·博索纳罗，后者得票率为48.21%，卢拉赢得连任。卢拉将于2027年
summary_en: Brazil's Superior Electoral Court released the second-round results of the presidential election late on October 25 local time. Workers' Party candidate and incumbent President Lula defeated Flávio Bolsonaro, the Liberal Party candidate and son of former President Jair Bolsonaro, by 51.79% to 48.21%, winning re-election. Lula will take office in 2027.

title: 津巴布韦总统呼吁西方国家无条件解除制裁
title_en: Zimbabwean president calls on Western countries to unconditionally lift sanctions
summary: 10月25日是南部非洲发展共同体反制裁日，津巴布韦总统姆南加古瓦当天发表讲话，呼吁西方国家无条件解除对津制裁。他表示，尽管面临制裁，津巴布韦仍在实现发展愿景方面取得进展，将继续扩大国际伙伴关系、深化区域一体化，以开拓市场、吸引投资和加速经济
summary_en: October 25 is the SADC Anti-Sanctions Day. Zimbabwean President Mnangagwa delivered a speech that day, calling on Western countries to unconditionally lift sanctions on Zimbabwe. He said that despite sanctions, Zimbabwe is making progress in realizing its development vision and will continue expanding international partnerships and deepening regional integration to open markets, attract investment and accelerate economic development.

title: 努力遏制电信网络诈骗蔓延（国际视点）
title_en: Efforts to curb spread of telecom and online fraud (International Perspectives)

title_en: Approaching the Long March, appreciating its spiritual strength
summary: 10月26日，来自106个驻华使馆和5个国际组织的驻华使节、外交官在北京中国人民革命军事博物馆参观“伟大的远征——纪念中国工农红军长征胜利90周年主题展览”。展览共分7个部分，展出照片图表357张、文物文献1061件（套），其中首次展出30
summary_en: On October 26, diplomatic envoys and diplomats from 106 embassies in China and five international organizations visited the exhibition 'The Great Expedition — Themed Exhibition Commemorating the 90th Anniversary of the Victory of the Long March of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army' at the Military Museum of the Chinese People's Revolution in Beijing. The exhibition is divided into seven parts, displaying 357 photographs and charts and 1,061 cultural relics and documents (sets), including over 30 items displayed for the first time.
